function.name: calc_absolute_pressure
function.description: Calculates the absolute pressure from gauge and atmospheric pressures. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

atm_pressure.description: The atmospheric pressure in atmospheres (atm). Default is 1 atm if not provided.

gauge_pressure.description: The gauge pressure in atmospheres (atm). Must be provided.

message.reasoning:
The user says: "計算給定大氣壓力為1大氣壓和計量壓力為2大氣壓的帕斯卡絕對壓力。" That means: "Calculate the absolute pressure in Pascals given atmospheric pressure of 1 atm and gauge pressure of 2 atm." So we need to compute absolute pressure = atm_pressure + gauge_pressure. atm_pressure default is 1 atm. gauge_pressure is 2 atm. So absolute pressure = 1 + 2 = 3 atm. Then convert to Pascals: 1 atm = 101325 Pa. So 3 atm = 3 * 101325 = 303975 Pa. So answer: 303975 Pa.
